name: Fred Johnson
reason: No own website found (two web searches, 4 Nov 2026): he appears only on third-party pages as a Tampa jazz vocalist, storyteller and arts-in-health programme manager (Straz Center, UCSF Sound Health Network, hospital 'music as medicine' events), so there is no published email or contact form of his own, and his work there is framed mainly as arts in health care rather than spiritual teaching. The name is also shared with other musicians, so identity could not be confirmed.
